tytul: Akcje serwisowe aut w UE – tydzień 47/2026: Citroën, Lexus and Toyota
lead: Wezwania samochodów do serwisu zgłoszone w unijnym systemie Safety Gate w 47. tygodniu 2026 r. – 2 pozycji.
tresc:
## Do uzupełnienia

Szkic bez tekstu – brak klucza modelu językowego. Opisy usterek poniżej są po angielsku: przetłumacz je w panelu przed publikacją.

zrodla.nazwa: Safety Gate – raport tygodniowy Report-2026-47 (Komisja Europejska)

pozycje.problem: The two retaining pins located on the brake pedal linkage of vehicles converted into driving school vehicles may not be installed properly. If one of these pins is not correctly lined up, the brake linkage may become misaligned and prevent the pedal from returning fully to its initial position after braking, which increases the risk of injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 24/07/2026

pozycje.model: 4RUNNER, AVENSIS, COROLLA, SEQUOIA, GX460, IS CONVERT, IS350/250, IS-F , SC430
pozycje.problem: The propellant in the driver airbag may deteriorate over time. If the airbags deploy, it could result in fragments from the inflator injuring the vehicle's occupants. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
